    Bitcoin vs Litecoin (BTC vs LTC)

    As of November 22, 2026 (Binance daily close): Bitcoin closed at $61,271.08 and Litecoin at $40.210, so 1 BTC = 1,523.777 LTC.

    ⚡ Live BTC price ⚡ Live LTC price 🔁 Convert BTC to LTC

    BTC vs LTC: what the numbers show

    Bitcoin's market cap of about $1.25T is 378 times Litecoin's ($3.32B); they rank #1 and #19 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Bitcoin fell 27.7% and Litecoin fell 51.0%, a gap of 23.3 percentage points in Bitcoin's favour. Litecoin was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (64.8% annualized against 46.8%). Within the year, Bitcoin's largest fall between daily closes was 39.5% and Litecoin's was 54.2%. On November 22, 2026 Bitcoin was 36.8% below its 52-week high and Litecoin 53.7% below its own. In 8 of the last 12 complete months, Bitcoin did better than Litecoin. Over the last 90 days the daily moves of Litecoin and Bitcoin had a correlation of 0.66 (closely tied; 1 would mean moving in lockstep).
